_published_faq.name: How do I add Hit The Road Rentals to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Hit The Road Rentals to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://hittheroad.rentals/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Hit The Road Rentals MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hit The Road Rentals provides these MCP tools: search_campervans and list_locations.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Hit The Road Rentals?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Hit The Road Rentals in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.

_published_faq.name: Does Hit The Road Rentals MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hit The Road Rentals does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Hit The Road Rentals?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hit The Road Rentals is developed by Wikah Pty Ltd - Trading as Hit The Road Rental. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
